content.comment_body: Hello everyone, could someone explain how to display an analog input value from a [product_name] to its built-in screen? Thank you.
Hi, you can place an analog amplifier after the AI, set Gain to 1 and Offset to 0, then include the AX output from the amplifier in a message.
